text: Late in a busy round, a blocked lane arose while the welfare lead was handling it. Incident Report: Blocked Lane at Companion Animal Travel Desk. The delay began when a pet transfer trolley stalled beside the check-in row, narrowing access and causing a brief crowding at the counter. Staff moved travelers back, checked the pet area, and kept Chester secure while the lead spoke with the ground team. <<FACT F117>> The service desk then redirected foot traffic, cleared loose items from the lane, and restored safe movement without further distress. One traveler expressed concern, and the senior coordinator documented the exchange and confirmed support. <<FACT F114>> Follow-up will review lane controls, handler spacing, and alert practice so the Companion Animal Travel Desk can prevent a repeat. All staff must treat any blockage as urgent and act at once. Companion Animal Travel Desk
